name: Mist-Lock Lantern (Tỏa Vụ Đăng)
lore: A pole-lantern of horn panes and black pine, the first mist lantern, hung by Hàm Thủ Lộ at the Trà Viên crossroads in 1050 (N-vu_an-01). In 1146 it was found burning on the road by empty Đồng Sơn Trấn, and nothing else of him was (N-vu_an-03). Bàng Yên Tỏa carries it. Hàm Thanh Đăng, the founder's daughter, wants it.
build_use: Holds the Mist-Lock field steady and keeps its keeper hard to hit.
notes: Stage 6 vu_an record pass: depth treasure grade 3 staged as rarity 4. cast_ward_duration_pct (+20) kept verbatim as open stat-sheet line (no fight/stat-sheet reader yet, same as vu_linh).

name: Bobtail Axe (Đoản Vĩ Phủ)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: A woodsman's axe re-hafted in lynx-bone, carried by the robbers of Đoản Vĩ Cương (1043). Its owner brought it with him when the founder hid him from Thúy Vi's patrol in 1081 (N-vu_an-02). It has killed men on both sides of the law.
build_use: The road captain's: hits hard coming out of the mist and stands in the road.

name: Milestone Flag (Lý Bia Kỳ)
lore: A grey road-flag painted with the same mist seal as the milestones; set in the ground, it is one more pin of the array.
build_use: Holding a mist field: evasion and linh lực.
